title: Screen: the drying page's Start button is enabled again when drying ends (it stayed grey after a screen restart during drying)
note: The drying settings page keeps a pointer to its Start button (saved in a free slot of .q2_queue_state when the page is drawn). When the drying state changes to 'not drying', the screen program re-evaluates that button with its own rule (disabled only while the printer is busy). Code: 12 instructions in the free part of .q2_queue_text.
